passages.P2: # Bon Jovi Plays at Biden Event After Candidate Visits Bucks County
passages.P3: ## While incumbent President Donald Trump was in North Carolina, Democratic candidate Joe Biden held drive-in rallies in Luzerne and Bucks counties in Pennsylvania Saturday.
passages.P4: #### By NBC Philadelphia Staff • Published October 24, 2020 • Updated on October 24, 2020 at 11:58 pm
passages.P6: “All eyes are on Pennsylvania,” former ambassador Nikki Haley tells NBC10’s Steven Fisher.
passages.P8:
* Joe Biden, Donald Trump and their surrogates are keeping a presence in Pennsylvania in the final days leading up to the 2020 presidential election.
* Biden appeared in Bucks and Luzerne counties Saturday as Trump planned to visit North Carolina and the midwest.
* Former ambassador Nikki Haley spoke to Trump supporters in Norristown on Saturday.
passages.P9: Rock star Jon Bon Jovi gave a small concert at a drive-in rally in eastern Pennsylvania for Joe Biden on Saturday, performing three songs and praising Biden's response to the coronavirus.
passages.P10: The rocker took the stage in Dallas, Pennsylvania, wearing a black face mask that he peeled off to play acoustic versions of “Who Says You Can’t Go Home?,” “Livin’ on a Prayer” and “Do What You Can,” which was recently released and dedicated to those on the front lines of the coronavirus pandemic.
passages.P11: Bon Jovi also pulled out notes to praise Biden, saying, “I wrote my comments down because I’ve never played at a drive-in with all the horns honking, so it’s a little different.”
passages.P12: The rocker added that “Joe knows that masks are not a sign of weakness, they’re a sign of strength."
passages.P13: Delivering a speech a short time later as hundreds of cars honked their horns in approval, Biden said that Bon Jovi has “always gone wherever I’ve asked him” and called him a friend and “national treasure.”
passages.P15: Singer Jon Bon Jovi performs during a Biden-Harris Drive-In event at Dallas High School, in Dallas, Pennsylvania, on October 24, 2020. (Photo by Angela Weiss / AFP) (Photo by ANGELA WEISS/AFP via Getty Images)
passages.P16: Biden held two drive-in rallies in Pennsylvania on Saturday and has said for months he expects to win a state that could play a critical role in deciding next month’s election.
passages.P17: Dallas is in Luzerne County, where Donald Trump beat Hillary Clinton by more than 25,000 votes in 2016. Dallas isn't far from Scranton - where Biden lived as a child - in neighboring Lackawanna County, where Clinton eked out a victory of a few thousand votes in 2016.
passages.P18: Biden was in Pennsylvania as was Nikki Haley, speaking for Trump in Norristown. The president is coming to Allentown and Lancaster on Monday. NBC10's Drew Smith reports.
passages.P20: Nikki Haley, the former ambassador to the United Nations, spoke for Trump at Montgomery County Community College in Norristown Saturday night.
passages.P21: Haley told NBC10's Steven Fisher: "all eyes are on Pennsylvania."
passages.P22:
> Thank you Norristown PA for a great welcome! We are having a great day contrasting what’s at stake in this election. Good energy for @realDonaldTrump as we head towards the finish line. Contact your friends and family and make sure they vote! ❤️🇺🇸#USStrong pic.twitter.com/iHbMNUBtWu
>
> — Nikki Haley (@NikkiHaley) October 24, 2020
passages.P24: Earlier Saturday, Biden held a drive-in rally in Bristol where Trump supporters could be heard making a ruckus from a short distance away.
